artworks.title: Farm and Row of Houses
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: This image shows a rural scene with rustic thatched-roof buildings. The horizon is relatively high, with a line of trees in the distance. The artwork is detailed in an engraving style, with fine lines creating texture in the roofs and walls. The color palette is muted, mostly grey and black. Pathways lead into the distance where buildings and sparse vegetation are situated. In the very background, more structures are partially obscured by trees.

artworks.title: Large Farm with Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic rural scene with thatched roofs on connected buildings. The horizon includes leafless and leafy trees. The style is fine, detailed etching. The sky has sparse clouds and two birds. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of gray. A patch of ground leads to the buildings, with larger trees on the right.

artworks.title: Country Village with Church Tower
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a village landscape viewed from a slightly elevated vantage point. Thatched-roof structures, trees, and a tall steeple form the skyline. The style features detailed engravings depicting textures like thatch and foliage. The color scheme is monochrome, highlighting the linework. Figures are shown walking, and more are visible further away, indicating daily activity. The village is closely packed with houses, surrounded by trees.

artworks.title: Country Village with Church
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with buildings and trees in the center. The horizon is in the upper third, dividing sky and land. Structures and a church steeple are surrounded by trees. The etching techniques show detailed texture and depth. Closest to us are cows grazing in a grassy area and ducks in water. The image uses monochromatic tones, mainly black and white.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape scene from a slightly elevated point of view, capturing a rustic village scene. The horizon is not prominently placed, as the perspective seems to blend seamlessly into the distant trees and rooftops. The scene features detailed cross-hatching and fine lines typical of engraving techniques, creating a textured appearance to convey the intricate details of the trees, buildings, and figures. A gathering of trees frames the left and right sides of the scene, with two figures to the left and a herder guiding a small herd of livestock towards the right. In the distance, thatched-roof cottages are clustered among more trees, giving a sense of a secluded village within a wooded area. The color palette consists predominantly of monochrome tones, with variations of light and shadow achieved through the use of line work, contributing to a muted visual impact. The composition suggests a serene, rural atmosphere without any bold or dramatic contrasts.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene featuring a cluster of rustic buildings, possibly houses with thatched roofs. The horizon is low, lining up closely with the rooftops and tree line. Tall trees rise up behind the buildings, delicately sketched against a light sky. The color palette is monochromatic, with black and grey tones dominating. The ground appears dusty or muddy with path markings. In the distance, a figure can be seen walking in the peaceful countryside setting.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a low vantage point. The horizon is high in the composition, aligning with the tree tops and thatched roofs. The drawing style shows detailed textures of houses, trees, and clouds using fine linear etching. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white. A path, fence, grass patches, houses, and trees are visible.

artworks.title: Farm
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated point. A dirt path extends into the distance, bordered by rows of trees. In the background, there is a dense cluster of trees and a structure with a spire, potentially a church in a small settlement. The artwork is rendered in a monochrome style with fine, linear strokes, resembling an etching. The color scheme consists of sepia tones. Figures of people walking on the path and a horseman riding to the left are visible. Two birds fly in the slightly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with thatched-roof cottages set among rolling hills. There are trees along the horizon, birds in the sky, and a pond in the foreground with ducks and cattle. There are figures tending to sheep near the cottages. The artwork is created using intricate etching techniques in black and white, emphasizing the details of the landscape.

artworks.title: The Swann's Inn with Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a low point of view looking across a rural landscape with various elements. The horizon is at the upper third, marked by trees and thatched-roof buildings. The etching style uses detailed lines for texture and depth, capturing the rustic atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink creating contrast on pale paper. In the foreground, scattered logs are seen, with individuals on horseback and foot along with a dog. Further back are more buildings, trees, and structures leading to the horizon. The composition has a pastoral feel with natural and architectural features intricately rendered.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene with cottages, barns, people, trees, a path, and a cloudy sky. The style is delicate etching, with monochrome colors used to convey texture and detail. The composition creates a serene ambiance.

artworks.title: Village Street with Hay Cart
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with farm buildings, trees, and a cottage with a thatched roof. Sparse leafless trees on the left, a pond with grazing cows and ducks, and a cart pulled by oxen on a dirt path. Figures in the distance between the buildings in a circular formation, surrounded by open land and a few trees. The sky above is filled with detailed scattered clouds. The scene is depicted in fine, detailed brushstrokes and etching, with a monochromatic color palette of various shades of grey.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a village in the distance. Cultivated fields lead to rustic houses with a low horizon. The style is precise, with detailed line work defining structures, vegetation, and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown and sepia. The sky is spacious and contrasts with the detailed features below.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Regiones et Villae Rusticae"
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle (publisher)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately framed text. The central part of the image consists of a block of text written in a classical serif font. The text references Cornelio Curtius and Theodoro Gallaeo and a location "ANTUERPIAE" (Antwerp). Surrounding this text is an elaborate decorative border featuring detailed illustrations of trees, flowers, and small animals. The trees on either side are inhabited by birds and a squirrel-like creature. At the bottom, the border contains lush foliage and a cluster of various plants, creating a symmetrical composition. The detailed design emphasizes the elegance of the announcement.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist Preaching
artworks.artist: Frans Crabbe van Espleghem
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered in a natural setting. The scene shows individuals within a cave or rocky shelter, surrounded by trees with lush foliage in the foreground. A figure gestures towards those inside the cave, with others standing behind him. The background features a rural landscape with a small village, buildings, and mountains in the distance. The sky has billowing clouds. The style includes detailed line work and attention to natural elements and architectural details.

artworks.title: King Louis XIII of France and Anne of Austria
artworks.artist: Cornelis van Dalen I
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of two individuals standing side by side. The man on the left has long, wavy hair, a mustache, and is wearing heavily adorned armor. The armor features intricate designs and a star emblem on his chest. A curtain, helmet, and feathers are visible in the background. The woman on the right holds an olive branch in her right hand, has shoulder-length wavy hair, and wears a gown with a lace collar and pearl accessories. The background includes drapery and a city skyline labeled "La Ville Royale de Paris."

artworks.title: Autumn (L'Automne)
artworks.artist: Charles-François Daubigny
artworks.description: The image shows a scenic landscape with hills, trees, water, a path, a man with a donkey, and grasslands. The scene is depicted with finely etched brushstrokes in a monochromatic color palette of brown or sepia tones.

artworks.title: Little Birds (Les Petits oiseaux)
artworks.artist: Charles-François Daubigny
artworks.description: The image shows a winding path through a wooded area with tall trees. The horizon is obscured by the trees, and the path curves gently into the distance. The landscape is depicted using fine lines and textures, with a color palette of sepia and brown. A small figure can be seen walking along the path in the distance. The sky is partly cloudy with a pattern of horizontal lines and shading.

artworks.title: Deer in the Woods (Les Cerfs sous bois)
artworks.artist: Charles-François Daubigny
artworks.description: The image shows a view from within a forest, where numerous tall, slender trees reach towards the top of the frame. The horizon line is unclear, and the trees dominate the scene vertically. In the distance, two deer are visible, one with antlers. The image is created in an etching style with fine lines depicting a dense mesh of branches and leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, in sepia and dark brown tones. Light filters through the trees, casting shadows on the ground.

artworks.title: A propos des... caves de la Banque de France
artworks.artist: Honoré Daumier
artworks.description: This drawing shows individuals observing construction work outside a building labeled "BANQUE DE FRANCE". Two figures are in the foreground - a man in a long coat and hat, and a woman in a dress. In the background, construction laborers are working near archways or tunnels. The image is in black and white with strong line work and shading, styled like 19th-century satirical illustrations. French text at the bottom references the new cellars of the Banque de France.

artworks.title: Au Camp de Chalons
artworks.artist: Honoré Daumier
artworks.description: This is an illustration of three figures standing together. On the left, an adult man with a coat and top hat holds an umbrella over himself and the woman next to him. The woman in the middle wears a bonnet and a dress with a bustle. She holds the man's arm, and her face is shown in profile with her hair styled up. A child is on the other side, pointing towards a group of soldiers practicing or marching in the rain in the background. The scene is outdoors with faint outlines of tents or structures suggesting a camp.

artworks.title: Ce que l'Angleterre appelle un trait-d'union
artworks.artist: Honoré Daumier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lion with a chain connecting it to a sitting figure. The image depicts a large, regal lion lying on the ground, its mane full and well-defined, gazing at the viewer with a somewhat fierce expression. The lion wears a crown, suggesting a symbol of power or royalty. Attached to the lion with a chain is a seated figure, which appears to be leaning back with a somewhat anxious or startled expression. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette, emphasizing the contrast and detail of the line work.

artworks.title: Chauds les gros! chauds!...
artworks.artist: Honoré Daumier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly, bearded figure standing beside a large steaming container filled with round objects. The figure, draped in a robe, holds a scythe or staff, gazing upward. The steam emanating from the cauldron forms cloud-like speech bubbles with inscriptions such as "QUESTION ROMAINE", "QUESTION D'ORIENT", and "QUESTION ALLE". The drawing is monochromatic with strong lines to depict contours and shading for depth. The style and subject matter suggest a satirical or allegorical intent common in 19th-century European political cartoons.

artworks.title: Consultations non gratuites
artworks.artist: Honoré Daumier
artworks.description: This image shows three figures standing in front of labeled doors. The figures are dressed in robes and hats, with the last figure wearing a helmet with a plume. Each figure is stationed in front of a door labeled with names, behind which there are indications of doctor consultations: "DOCTEUR," "DREYSE," "CHASSELOT," and "NOËL." The setting appears to be a hallway, with the caption "CONSULTATIONS NON-GRATUITES" at the bottom. The art style features fine lines and shading, portraying character expressions in a satirical manner.
